# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen or eighteen at the time of her wedding, progressing to her mid-twenties in later volumes  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c26 P15](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0015), [v1 c28 P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v3 c29 P11](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0011), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c16 P12](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, glossy dark tresses, rosy cheeks, and enchanting dimples. She has a rounder, fuller figure that she lightheartedly compares to a dumpling. As she grows into adulthood and becomes a mother, she takes on a somewhat matronly appearance while retaining her dark curls and vibrant complexion.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c33 P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 c33 P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Diana is cheerful, agreeable, and affectionate, always laughing before she speaks and eager for companionship. She possesses a frank and frank-hearted nature, although she lacks the dramatic imagination of her best friend Anne. She is obedient to her strict mother and revere conventional propriety, yet she harbors a fondness for romantic stories, festive gatherings, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P17](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0017), [v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v3 c12 P20](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0020), [v3 c12 P21](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0021), [v3 c12 P22](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0022)_

## History

Diana meets Anne Shirley when Anne comes to live at Green Gables, and the two quickly swear an oath of eternal friendship. Their early playfulness includes building playhouses, inventing story plots, and naming local landmarks like Idlewild and Willowmere. Their friendship faces a crisis when Diana inadvertently becomes intoxicated on Marilla's homemade currant wine, leading her mother to forbid them from playing together; however, Diana's mother relents after Anne saves Diana's younger sister, Minnie May, during a severe attack of croup. Diana joins the Avonlea Story Club and partakes in various school activities, though her parents choose not to send her to Queen's Academy. As they grow up, Diana becomes engaged to Fred Wright and eventually marries him. She gives birth to her first child, a daughter named Anne Cordelia, keeping her childhood bond with Anne at the heart of her family life.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 c18 P19](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0019), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c26 P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v3 c29 P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010), [v3 c29 P11](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0011), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_
